512-1606-2085.easyPrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.

Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.

423-1362-1437-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.

In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1362-1437-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.
